Fix zoho mail server issue like :sender's email id must same as outgoing mail server email id."
Now no need to use mail server per user.
Sender's name will be managed dynamically based on sender regardless of outgoing email address.
Managed proper reply-to in order to receive proper reply from the send mail.
Supports Odoo Community as well as Enterprise versions.

The problem arises after setting up zoho mail server in odoo and sending the mail with having different mail of sender then outgoing mail server.

You can see the Email sending will be failed.

After installing the module, In setting go to outgoing mail servers (needs to enable the developer mode).

Set all configuration and click on test connection for success full connection.

Set default server true and again send email.

Check the email status, now you will find the success status of email.
